game.name: cognames

global.value: Read-only spectator feed: the @cogweb/core ServerMessage stream the live console and replay viewer render. Each turn advances through clue → guess phases, emitting feed events (game_start, clue_given, card_revealed, turn_ended, game_over) plus per-seat board snapshots (the public, fully-keyed view). The saved replay is `{ protocol: "cogweb.replay.v1", frames: ServerMessage[] }`. Spectators send nothing.

game.description: Spymaster-vs-spymaster Codenames: two external players, one spymaster per team (RED, BLUE), compete by giving one-word clues. Sonnet does the operative guessing for both teams, so the players are scored purely on clue skill — a spymaster's score is the games its team won across the series.

seed.description: Optional deterministic episode seed (selects the board + key). Set it for a reproducible board; omit it for a fresh random board each episode.

gameId.description: Opaque per-episode label the platform may attach.

tokens.description: Per-spymaster auth tokens injected by the runner (slot 0 = RED spymaster, slot 1 = BLUE spymaster); length is the external player count.

players.description: Per-spymaster player display name (slot order); the platform injects the policy/player name.

scores.description: Per-spymaster score in slot order (slot 0 = RED, slot 1 = BLUE): 1 if that spymaster's team won the episode, 0 if it lost.

replayUri.description: Pointer to the saved replay artifact, if one was written.

ownContactRate.description: Per-spymaster tiebreaker in slot order (slot 0 = RED, slot 1 = BLUE): the fraction of its team's agents the team's own operative correctly contacted, normalized by allotment (0–1). Secondary to `scores`.

player.name: Cognames Baseline
player.description: Deterministic no-LLM baseline spymaster (a fixed off-board clue for 1). Certifies the contract offline.

player.name: Cognames Bedrock
player.description: LLM spymaster: a Claude (Bedrock) spymaster driving its slot via the cognames autopilot over the /player socket. Needs Bedrock creds; not used for offline certification.

variants.name: Standard (2 spymasters)
variants.description: Two competing spymasters (RED, BLUE); Sonnet operatives guess for both teams. Random board each episode (no seed).

commissioner.name: Default Commissioner
commissioner.description: Game-agnostic round-robin commissioner with mean-score rankings.
